claim: Every input key in a batch receives exactly one attributable success or failure outcome, in a fixed order — nothing silently dropped, nothing double-counted.
denial_type: n/a — this app returns one Outcome per key

steps.label: a batch where half the actions fail
steps.note: A failure partway through does not truncate the batch. Every key is still attempted and still answered.

steps.label: no key is dropped and no key is answered twice

request.check: set of outcome keys == set of input keys

steps.note: Dropped and double-counted both leave a total that still looks plausible.

steps.label: outcomes arrive in the batch's own order, run after run
steps.evidence: fixed order, so two runs can be compared line by line
